rows.grounds: fused form: agniṣṭoma-śata (hundred Agniṣṭoma rites) in genitive with enclitic api (even); internal sandhi noted, token not split
verb expressing acquisition of a result or reward
compound: phala (fruit, result) + uttama (supreme, highest); object of labhate

items.question: What supreme reward is gained that equals the merit of a hundred Agniṣṭoma sacrifices?
premises: A hundred Agniṣṭoma sacrifices constitute a great ritual measure of merit.
The verse asserts the obtaining of a fruit associated with even that hundredfold performance.
The fruit obtained is characterized as supreme.
items.inference: Therefore, the stated attainment yields the supreme fruit equivalent to performing a hundred Agniṣṭoma sacrifices.
uncertainties: The subject who obtains this fruit is supplied by the preceding verses and is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One obtains the supreme fruit, equal to that of even a hundred Agniṣṭoma sacrifices.
